source_of_truth: Operator contract (2026-06-07): the architecture surface is an evidence-backed reconciler, not a single-source oracle — every node/edge must carry what-it-is + where-inferred-from + freshness + confidence + observed-vs-inferred, with an extractor-coverage block and as_built/intent layers + drift taxonomy. Captured in memory project_architecture_evidence_reconciler. Generalizes the render-truth scope contract (suppress-unless-proven, mark-stale, never-present-inferred-as-fact) from per-node liveness to the architecture model. Builds on the view-state produced by scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/architecture_view_state.build_view_state (the model the 2026-06-06-007 interactive map consumes).
completion_test: build_view_state emits, for EVERY node and edge, source_kind + confidence + evidence_basis + provenance; unresolved references appear as low-confidence inferred edges (never dropped); a top-level coverage block enumerates evidence kinds covered vs missing (absent extractors render limited/low, not confident); the model is split into as_built + intent layers with a defined diff taxonomy (intent + diff EMPTY in v0). NO new extractor (Swift/Gradle/Xcode/JS/routing/API/infra), NO ADR/doc ingestion, NO UI overhaul — all deferred to later plans.
